## Tier 1 — Actively Monitor
1. **Rapamycin clinical trials** — PEARL trial Phase 2 ongoing; watch for full
   results. Human safety/efficacy data is the gap to fill. Source: pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov
2. **AI agent reliability** — Tool-calling accuracy is the limiting factor for
   Zeke autonomy. Monitor Berkeley BFCL leaderboard for model improvements.
   Current ceiling: ~88% multi-step. Gap: real-world reliability below benchmark.

## Tier 2 — Periodic Check (Weekly)
3. **Spaced repetition implementation** — Apply double-spacing intervals to Zeke
   feed review. Research is settled; priority shifts to implementation.
4. **Treasury yields** — 10Y at 3.95%, Fed holding. Monitor for rate cut signals
   that affect TLT position.

## Tier 3 — Diminishing Returns (Reduce Feed Weight)
5. **tool-calling general** — Saturated. Consolidate to monthly summary.
6. **compound-synthesis** — Derivable locally; not worth dedicated feed slots.
7. **AI agent benchmarks (general)** — High noise/signal ratio; filter to
   specific named tools only (Claude Code, Lovable, Cursor).

## Feed Health Notes
- Dedup pass needed: tool-calling topic has 8+ near-identical entries this cycle
- compound-synthesis entries should be generated locally, not ingested as feed
- Quality scoring working well; 4-5 scores are surfacing genuinely useful content

# Zeke Strategic Context
Last distilled: 2026-03-19

## System Architecture
- **Core Compute**: DGX Spark GPU running Nemotron 3 Nano (30B MoE, 3B active). Throughput 76 tok/s vs qwen3-32b 9.6 tok/s (8x gain). Spark cleaned post-recovery: 187.5GB → 50GB.
- **Model Routing**: config/spark-models.json = single source of truth. spark_models.py get_model(task_type) dispatcher routes reasoning/fast/extraction/scoring/coding/synthesis/embedding to optimal model. All 7 cron scripts refactored to use router. Zero hardcoded model names.
- **Memory System**: openclaw (v2026.3.11 post-recovery), session-journal.jsonl (mandatory on structural changes), anti-patterns.md (decision history). Memory index: 34/38 files, 113 chunks, fresh daily.
- **Feedback Loop**: alpha-feedback.py parses source_type from source field. alpha-scanner.py reads accuracy weights, adjusts conviction dynamically. First run: ideas differentiated 5/6/7 vs flat 5/8.
- **Data Quality**: Learning feed (7,130 entries). Auto-cleanup of malformed JSON. Gateway healthy (PID 88639, RPC probe OK). Ollama fallback for GPU metrics if SSH unavailable.
- **Availability**: Recovered 2026-03-18 from 39-hour outage (3/15-3/17). Root: openclaw sandbox.mode="true" on Mac Mini (no Docker). FIXED: sandbox.mode="off", removed bad config keys (ownerDisplay, streaming).
